scripts.dev: bun run native:build && bun run --parallel dev:web dev:desktop
scripts.native:build: swift build --package-path native/speechd && swift build --package-path native/notch-geometry
scripts.native:build:release: swift build -c release --package-path native/speechd && swift build -c release --package-path native/notch-geometry
scripts.package: bun run native:build:release && turbo run build && bun run --cwd apps/desktop package
scripts.package:unsigned: bun run native:build:release && turbo run build && bun run --cwd apps/desktop package:unsigned
scripts.package:signed: bun run native:build:release && turbo run build && bun run --cwd apps/desktop package:signed
scripts.package:install: bun run package:signed && bun run --cwd apps/desktop install:mac
